description: DL-08 inbound event sources for scripts/event_intake_surface.ts. Every source is disabled by default; enabling one requires the HMAC secret under secret_key in the secret store. tenant_slug binds a source to one tenant (events land under the tenant namespace and only that tenant's dots see them). Replay dedupe: a same-source event whose raw-body digest matches one seen within replay_window_hours (default 24) is dropped as a duplicate, even when its event type differs, because type and delivery headers are unsigned. A source whose sender legitimately repeats identical bodies under different event types must set replay_window_hours lower, or 0 to disable payload-digest dedupe (delivery-id dedupe still applies).
